description: Multi-Tenant Phase 4F.1 (extended in Phase 4G for generation-versioned artifacts) -- the canonical Blob key layout for a BLOB-mode tenant's durable storage. Both dashboard/api/_lib/tenantBlobKeys.js (Node) and tenant_blob_keys.py (Python) must compute the LITERAL SAME keys from the same tenantId -- this fixture is the shared contract both languages' test suites validate their own formula against.
notes: relPath/generation validation is defense-in-depth only -- the primary guard against a malformed relPath is each caller's own allowlist (e.g. data.js's buildRequestedRelPath()), and generation ids are always server-computed (uuid4 hex, initial_sync.py), never caller-supplied. The generation namespace is a SIBLING of reviews.db/the flat private-data prefix under the tenant's root, not nested under it -- see generation_root()/generationRoot().
